statement: For every odd prime p, put t = p − 1 and let Et be Morava E-theory for the height-t Honda formal group over kt = Fpt , with its coherent stabilizer action. The pure stabilizer St contains a finite subgroup H ∼ = Cp ⋊ Ct2 for which ˆ︁ H∗ (H; (Et)∗) = kt[α, β±1 , ∆±1 ]/(α2 ), |α| = (1, 2t), |β| = (2, 2pt), |∆| = (0, 2pt2 ). (14) The ordinary-to-Tate comparison is multiplicative and identifies Hs(H; (Et)q) with the displayed Tate group for every s > 0 and q.
